_note: Front page copy, one edition per bi-daily release. `front_copy.py --stamp <date>` sets which one is live and `build_cards.py` renders it - the copy used to be written into build_cards.py's template, which made it impossible to rotate without editing a generator, and it was invisible there next to the counts. Appended, never rewritten: the sequence of what the front page said is the record. The hub teasers are NOT here - they come from each story's own `take`, cut at sentence boundaries by `deck()` in build_cards.py, so they change when the stories do.
